html:
Roman emperor from 379 to 395, and the last to rule both the east and the west. He was a general from Spain, made co-emperor by Gratian after the disaster at Adrianople.

He ended the Gothic War in 382 with a treaty that let the Goths live inside the empire as allies under their own leaders. Later historians saw this as a step toward the fall of the west.

His larger mark was on religion. In 380 the Edict of Thessalonica made Nicene Christianity the state faith, and in 381 the First Council of Constantinople settled the creed. In the 390s he banned pagan sacrifice. After he ordered a massacre at Thessalonica in 390, Bishop Ambrose of Milan made him do public penance.

He won two civil wars, the last at the Frigidus in 394. When he died in 395 his sons Arcadius and Honorius took the east and west. The empire was never again ruled by one man.
sum: Roman emperor from 379 to 395, and the last to rule both the east and the west. He was a general from Spain, made co-emperor by Gratian after the disaster at Adrianople.
